snippet.title: Sonic Saga: The Mystery Of South Island - SAGE 2025 DEMO Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
After some time of work, I can finally announce the first demo of my project! As stated at the end of the trailer, It'll be available at SAGE 2025.

Sonic Saga is an RPG game for the Gameboy Color system, powered by GBStudio. It was inspired by the classic JRPGs.

More info (Soon): https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-saga-the-mystery-of-south-island.2464/
